notes.title: Update notes for 24/03/2024
notes.content:
Fixed the following issues reported:
[list]
[*] Arrow keys added as player inputs as an alternative to W,S,A,D 
[*] Changed default camera from cinematic third person to isometric top down. (Also adjusted the set piece statues to be visible even when the view is top down)
[*] Increased the size of Game settings dropdown popup items.
[*] Enabled mouse on Game Over screen (Mouse+KB users)
[*] Enabled mouse on Game Pause screen (Mouse+KB users)
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome. But why the name "PRIN-C1"?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647734/6874c48192ca566ae23f1d01c39f7a447483bb20.png[/img]
Hello folks. I love dogs and I love video games. Hence  I picked this theme: Endless Runner with a dog. 

This is also my first game development project. So I really appreciate your time and feedback on this. 

Why the name PRIN-C1? -  It's named after my deceased dog Princy. She loves food very much. This game is in her memory.
